neighbours.label: The token ':\n' (colon then line break) closing a prose lead-in that announces what comes next; a mid-line colon or a full stop before the line break stays quiet
fire:
If you liked this recipe, please pass it on to your family, telling them that:
“It only takes ten minutes.”

I was not sure where to ask about this, so I am writing my question here:
My laptop will not charge.

This post is part of our series on:
Growing vegetables in small gardens.

Before the meeting, the manager sent everyone this message:
Please bring your reports.

The sign on the door said the following:
Closed until further notice.

Here are the benefits that the club offers to new members:
- Free parking

The procedure, in short, works as follows:
First the sample is heated.

After a long silence she finally gave her answer:
I will stay.
